verdict.rationale: Mollie delivers event triggers: next-gen webhooks let you permanently subscribe to specific event types (payment paid, payment creation, invoice creation, onboarding status changes), with HMAC-signed delivery and an events audit API. It also has a few fixed built-in automations, such as application fees moved automatically when a payment succeeds and auto-capture when a Magento order is marked shipped. However, there is no documented user-defined rules engine; you must build the condition-to-action logic yourself in your own webhook handler. Missing for 10: a native configurable rules/automation builder, user-defined conditions mapped to actions without custom code, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
